name: accounting-study-terms
about: Twenty questions a student would actually ask of the 67 accounting study-term notes lj adopted in commit 201bb05, written after reading all 67. Sixteen are answerable and name the note(s) that genuinely answer them; four are deliberately unanswerable - a retriever that returns something for every question is failing, and only a set containing questions with no right answer can catch that. Expectations are note ids because lj's titles carry typos ('Perpetual inventory Systerm') that a title match would silently miss.

questions.question: if an invoice says 2/10 n/30 how much do I take off and how long do I have to pay?
questions.note: the only note that states the 2% / 10 days / 30 days numbers

questions.question: which shipping term makes the seller pay the freight, and when does the buyer take ownership?
questions.note: FOB Destination: seller pays, ownership transfers on arrival

questions.question: goods are on a truck right now - whose inventory are they in if we bought them free on board at the factory?
questions.note: paraphrases FOB shipping point without using the phrase

questions.question: what is the quick ratio formula and what value counts as healthy?
questions.note: 'quick ratio' is the synonym lj's notes mostly call acid-test

questions.question: how do I work out gross margin ratio and what does the percentage mean?
questions.note: formula plus the 'dollar left over to cover expenses' reading

questions.question: under first in first out which units get charged to cost of goods sold?
questions.note: spells out FIFO rather than using the acronym

questions.question: when prices are rising which inventory costing method leaves the highest net income?
questions.note: only the comparison table answers the rising-prices case

questions.question: what do I do when the market value of inventory drops below what I paid?
questions.note: lower of cost or market, asked the way it comes up in homework

questions.question: what is the difference between recording a purchase at the full invoice amount and recording it already discounted?
questions.note: gross vs net method, described rather than named

questions.question: does a periodic system record cost of goods sold at every sale or only at the end of the period?
questions.note: three notes each hold half of this; any of them answers it

questions.question: how do I get cost of goods sold from beginning inventory, purchases and ending inventory?
questions.note: the COGS identity

questions.question: what gets added and subtracted to reach net purchases?
questions.note: purchases + freight in - returns/allowances - discounts

questions.question: what is shrinkage and what causes it?
questions.note: the easiest question in the set: title words appear verbatim

questions.question: the customer is unhappy but wants to keep the item for a partial refund - what is that called?
questions.note: allowance vs return; the return note is the near-miss distractor

questions.question: what is the order of the steps in the accounting cycle, from journal to balance sheet?
questions.note: the only note that lists the cycle in order

questions.question: who does a wholesaler sell to compared with a retailer?
questions.note: both halves are one line each in two tiny notes

questions.question: how do I compute straight-line depreciation on a piece of equipment?
questions.note: nothing in Resources covers depreciation methods - only a dangling [[Depreciated Expence]] link

questions.question: what are the three sections of the statement of cash flows?
questions.note: 'cash flow' appears nowhere in 30-Resources

questions.question: what journal entry records payroll taxes withheld from an employee?
questions.note: 'payroll' appears nowhere in 30-Resources

questions.question: how is a partnership taxed differently from a sole proprietorship?
questions.note: neither word appears anywhere in 30-Resources
